cohort: Hospitalized pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection in their second half of pregnancy at Edgardo Rebagliati Martins National Hospital.
finding: While cesarean section and iatrogenic preterm delivery rates were higher in severe COVID-19 cases, vaginal deliveries increased over time, no maternal deaths occurred, and no direct perinatal complications from COVID-19 were identified.
mod_finding: The study found a high overall cesarean section rate (60%), but noted that vaginal deliveries doubled over the study period.
